compartment.title: Analyzed image pipeline and proposed improvement phases

compartments.compartment: The user asked for easier‑to‑read, more fun lessons with relevant images. I inspected the current image handling across the web, AI, and DB layers, identified that image URLs were never exposed to the AI and that the visual references gallery duplicated images. I outlined a three‑phase plan: Phase A to fix the pipeline, Phase B for readability tweaks, and Phase C for fun enhancements. U: I need help in planning an enhancement to the lessons. I want the lessons to be easier to read, and more fun. There must be some way to be able to find and attach images to the lessons, but I don't know how to get pictures that are relevant and/or accurate?

compartment.title: Implemented Phase A: image URL injection, fallback injection, and gallery deduplication

compartments.compartment: The user approved the plan. I added code to inject up‑to‑eight search image URLs as markdown into the lesson generation prompt, created a new `injectImagesIntoLesson` post‑processor that inserts images into sections when the AI provides none, and updated the Visual References component to deduplicate images via a Set. All unit, integration, and E2E tests passed and the changes were committed as `origin/main`. U: Yes go with your plan

compartment.title: Verified that existing lessons contain no images and explained the fixes

compartments.compartment: The user asked to see an example lesson with images. I queried the database across several curricula and confirmed that every lesson currently has zero images, both inline and in source metadata. I then explained how the new pipeline fixes this for future generations and noted that the image providers may still return none if not configured. U: Does any of the generated lessons include images as of now, I want to look at an example

compartment.title: Implemented Phase B: summary extraction and callout separator

compartments.compartment: The user indicated missing image providers and requested to move to Phase B. I added logic to extract the final summary/key‑takeaways section from lesson markdown and render it in a highlighted card, and I introduced a thin horizontal rule between callout label and body for visual clarity. All tests passed and the changes were pushed as `origin/main`. U: I don't think I've created a tavily account, and searxng isn't installed yet. So that's probably why.. Let's continue with phase B instead, and I'll verify images another day

compartment.title: Confirmed commit and push of Phase B changes

compartments.compartment: The user asked to commit and push. I checked the repository state and confirmed that the previous changes were already committed and pushed to `origin/main`. U: commit the changes, and push

compartment.title: Collected fun‑enhancement preferences and listed possible improvements

compartments.compartment: The user expressed dislike for confetti and asked for other fun ideas. I suggested a sticky section navigator, an image‑quality gate, inline image captions with source attribution, and a glossary of bolded terms. The user approved all. U: yes do all of them

compartment.title: Implemented Phase C: section navigator, image quality gate, captions, and key‑terms card

compartments.compartment: Following the approval, I added a compact “On this page” navigator that appears when a lesson has three or more sections, replaced raw `` tags with a `LessonImage` component that shows a skeleton while loading and a graceful fallback on error, displayed alt‑text and source domain under each image, and built a “Key Terms” badge card that extracts bolded terms from the markdown. All lint, type‑check, unit, integration, and E2E suites passed and the changes were pushed as `origin/main`. U: yes do all of them

compartment.title: Added three screenshots to the repository and updated the README

compartments.compartment: The user requested visual assets for the README. I used Playwright to capture landing, explore, and onboarding pages, placed the images in a new `screenshots/` folder, optimized file sizes, and edited the README to embed the three screenshots with descriptive captions. The updates were committed and pushed as `origin/main`. U: Could you take a few screenshots of the site for the readme. Do 3 that represents the application best and add them to the readme

compartment.title: Added dynamic lesson categories/subcategories and search support

compartments.compartment: The user wanted lesson categorisation and search. I added nullable `category` and `subcategory` text columns to `curricula`, extended the AI `curriculumPlanSchema` with `categorySlug`/`subcategorySlug` so the model can suggest them, and allowed the user to override on the curriculum page. The public tRPC router now accepts optional `categorySlug`, `subcategorySlug`, and `search` parameters for filtered publishing lists, and a new `listCategories` procedure returns distinct categories/subcategories. The web and mobile explore pages were updated with filter chips and a server‑side search bar. E2E fixture resolver was extended for the new procedures, and all tests pass. U: The lessons should have a category, and a subcategory, to make it easier for users to find lessons they are interested in. You should be able to filter on category (optional) Ideally I'd like to add some sort of search functionality, but I don't know what to search for. Do you have any ideas of what to include in a search? U: Is it a good idea to add categories for lessons that don't exist yet? Maybe add categories as they're created. I think the ai can classify, but maybe let the user override this plan looks good

facts.ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS: * Image URLs are appended to the lesson generation prompt as markdown and limited to eight per lesson. * `injectImagesIntoLesson` post‑processor inserts up to four search images into section headings when the AI provides none. * Visual References gallery deduplicates images using a Set so each URL appears only once. * Lesson page renders a SectionNavigator when a lesson contains three or more `##` sections. * Lesson page replaces raw `` with a `LessonImage` component that shows a skeleton placeholder and a graceful “Image unavailable” fallback. * Inline images display a caption with italicised alt text and the source domain to the right of the image. * Bolded terms are extracted into a “Key Terms” badge card shown after the Sources section, capped at twenty unique terms. * The README now includes three screenshots (landing, explore, onboarding) stored in `screenshots/`. * `curricula` tables have nullable `category` and `subcategory` text columns; AI schema includes `categorySlug` and `subcategorySlug` for automatic classification, editable by the user. * Public tRPC router `listPublished` supports optional `categorySlug`, `subcategorySlug`, and free‑text `search` parameters; a new `listCategories` procedure returns distinct category values. * Web and mobile explore pages display filter chips for categories and a server‑side search bar over title, description, and user learning‑profile topic.
facts.WORKFLOW_RULES: * When adding new tRPC procedures, update the `resolveData` resolver in `apps/web/tests/e2e/fixtures.ts` to prevent unhandled procedure paths from breaking E2E tests.
